verdict.rationale: Kong ships an official CLI, kongctl, documented at developer.konghq.com/kongctl. It supports declarative configuration-as-code and imperative commands for one-off operations and inspection, and has an AI Gateway conversion extension for migrating configurations. The pages about proxying third-party AI CLIs describe traffic routing, not Kong's own CLI, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI ergonomics (e.g., machine-readable output or non-interactive auth for AI workflows), detail on which AI Gateway entities kongctl can manage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
